ShipModule.Name: Klingon Battlecruiser Hull Plate (Medium)
ShipModule.Description: Heavy plate for the battlecruisers of the Empire, thick and unadorned. "...a military ship, not a pleasure craft." (Captain K'Vada, TNG: "Unification I") Gives almost no protection against fire; it is there to soak up damage. Of the Klingon ship plates of its size, it is the cheapest to build and the easiest to repair, but the most fragile.
